data.text: MC 26.3 shader gotchas: server resource packs always sit above user packs, so a user pack cannot replace a core shader the server pack ships. It can still override an include file the server shader pulls in (e.g. minecraft:globals.glsl) and hook main() with a function-like macro. Includes are resolved by glslang through the shaderc include callback, which respects #if and has no Java-side dedupe. #version 330 shaders cannot use '\' line continuation or gl_BaseVertex. Harness: ~/dev/mc-shader-harness/run.sh.
